def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    net_income = 2_500_000
    basic_shares = 300_000
    options_warrants = 30_000
    exercise_price = 20
    market_price = 30

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    proceeds = options_warrants * exercise_price
    repurchased_shares = proceeds / market_price
    additional_shares = options_warrants - repurchased_shares
    diluted_shares = basic_shares + additional_shares
    diluted_eps = net_income / diluted_shares

    # return answer
    return round(diluted_eps, 2)
